role: The mooshroom: a cow that fills a bowl with mushroom stew, is milked like a cow, and is sheared into a plain cow plus five red mushrooms.

members.name: interact
members.note: the bowl, the bucket (EntityCow) and the shears: setDead, a plain cow with the mooshroom's position, angles, health and body yaw, five red mushrooms at posY + height with no pickup delay, the shears' wear; details-mobs-s1; the bowl into a free slot, a full inventory (nothing) and a last bowl: iu-milk-s1. The shears' damageItem(1, player) is surv_damage_stack (server only), and interactWith's destroyCurrentEquippedItem drops a worn-out pair (surv_destroy_current_item).
